title: Binary search hid an overflow bug for years
body: The classic midpoint formula (low + high) / 2 overflows for large arrays, turning a correct algorithm into a crash. The bug sat in textbooks and in Java's own library until Joshua Bloch publicised it in 2006. Writing low + (high - low) / 2 avoids ever forming the too-large sum.
source_hint: Bloch, 'Nearly All Binary Searches Are Broken', 2006
